sources.title: FLUX.2 Klein 4B & 9B LoRA Training with Ostris AI Toolkit
sources.snippet: Train FLUX.2 Klein 4B and 9B LoRAs with Ostris AI Toolkit. This guide covers Base vs Distilled expectations, 4B/9B compatibility rules, dataset design for character/style/product LoRAs, VRAM planning, quantization settings, and how to fix common Klein-specific issues like 9B collapse patterns.
